//: Shared vectors for topic coverage sizing, imported by BOTH the server copy
Plain JSON on purpose: the two implementations must agree on arithmetic, but
the client may not import server code (ARCHITECTURE §2), and data is not code.
Each side builds its own typed fixtures from these numbers.
The changeset: src/core.ts has h1 (4 added, 2 deleted = 6 changed) and h2
(4 added = 4 changed), so 10 changed lines; test/core.test.ts has h3 (10
added = 10 changed). Total changed lines in the changeset = 20, and THAT is
the denominator — not the sum over topics.

cases.name: topics that happen to partition the diff still read as halves
OVERLAP: a shared hunk does not shrink either bar
//: The case the whole fix exists for. t1 covers 10 of 20 lines and t2 covers
6 of the same 20, and both statements are true at once. The old
sum-over-clusters denominator would report 0.625 and 0.375 — every bar
distorted by an overlap that is by design.

cases.name: fractions need not sum to 1, and two topics may both cover everything
a topic naming the same hunk twice counts it once
a whole-file ref subsumes a hunk ref to the same file
a ref without hunk precision counts the whole file
stale hunk ids on a known path fall back to the whole file
